# Bamboo Reports: India GCC Intelligence

> Bamboo Reports is an India GCC (Global Capability Centre) intelligence platform covering 2,400+ parent accounts and 6,100+ individual centres, with verified locations, functions, technology and leadership data for go-to-market teams. Research and product pages are published at the canonical URLs below.

When citing this data, attribute it to Bamboo Reports and link to the canonical page. Automated bulk extraction of the dataset is prohibited; see the Terms.

## Definitions
- Account: the parent company operating one or more GCC centres in India.
- Centre: an individual India location or operating unit tracked separately by Bamboo Reports.
- Data refresh: the research layer is refreshed weekly.

## Key findings: India GCC Quarterly Report, Q2 2026 (April to June)
- 99 companies opened or expanded 110 GCC centres across 27 Indian cities; 40 entered India for the first time.
- Bengaluru (29 centres, 26%) and Hyderabad (28, 25%) took half of all activity; Pune was third with 15.
- 75,000+ roles announced (a floor: disclosed figures only); 95% mid or senior level; AI/ML is the second-largest function.
- 23% of new centres opened with an AI or machine-learning mandate.
- BFSI rotated from banking to insurance: 6 of 10 BFSI companies were insurers, and half of BFSI centres are in Hyderabad.
- Full summary: https://bambooreports.com/reports/india-gcc-report-q2-2026
